subject.title: config: use datetime suffix for config backup files instead of numeric rotation

question: Should timestamped config backups preserve or convert existing numbered `.bak.N` recovery points, or may the migration delete them when the suffix scheme changes?
rationale: Config backups may be a user's only recovery copy, and OpenClaw policy treats config recovery and migration behavior as compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only cleanup choice.

options.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
options.body: Require this PR or a replacement to carry existing `.bak.N` files into the new bounded timestamp retention set without silently deleting recovery points.

options.title: Explicitly Prune Legacy Backups
options.body: Accept first-run deletion of numbered backups as an intentional cleanup tradeoff and document that upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Keep Numeric Ring For Now
options.body: Reject the timestamped naming change until maintainers settle the backup migration and recovery contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve Or Convert Legacy Backups
recommendation.body: Require this PR or a replacement to carry existing `.bak.N` files into the new bounded timestamp retention set without silently deleting recovery points.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible history on the backup helper and config recovery semantics.
